from pathlib import Path
import ast, collections
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687704/attempts/d0cbcca9117b44429be50328a5ec3220/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ec33eed7.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full single-color rows and columns mark the partition lines.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    separator_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows] + [grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols]
    sep_color = max(set(separator_colors), key=separator_colors.count) if separator_colors else None
    row_cuts = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_bands = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(row_cuts, row_cuts[1:]) if b > a + 1]
    col_bands = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(col_cuts, col_cuts[1:]) if b > a + 1]
    blocks = []
    for r0, r1 in row_bands:
        for c0, c1 in col_bands:
            blocks.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
    # The repeated block is the one with the most distinct non-background colors.
    vals = [grid[r][c] for r0, r1, c0, c1 in blocks for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
    bg = collections.Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def score(b):
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = b
        cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
        return (sum(v != bg for v in cells), len(set(cells)))
    template = max(blocks, key=score)
    tr0, tr1, tc0, tc1 = template
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in row_bands:
        for c0, c1 in col_bands:
            if r1-r0 != tr1-tr0 or c1-c0 != tc1-tc0:
                continue
            for dr in range(r1-r0):
                for dc in range(c1-c0):
                    out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = grid[tr0+dr][tc0+dc]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
